headline: Chipmakers boom: SK Hynix record listing, TSMC record quarter
body: A quiet day. SK Hynix made a record Nasdaq debut to fund new fabs, and TSMC posted record quarterly revenue of about $39.6 billion on AI chip demand. Both add to Capability Velocity, lifting Enslaved God, Descendants and Zookeeper and pushing Reversion down. Horizon Balance: +0.78.
movers_note: Reversion -0.1, Enslaved God +0.1 and Descendants +0.1, from the TSMC and SK Hynix results (Reversion -0.07 from TSMC alone).
